question: how many times has stock come in to the spare parts store

Zero is the data. Store chosen so its name cannot be misread as a product line, its fragment matches exactly one warehouse, and its zero is not a fact the dev suite's notes already spotlight. Different root cause from hq-06 on purpose, so the two cases do not fail together.
